day_plan.note: Requested 8 AM start. Earliest start on the official Venetian calendar that was checked on 2026-11-17 is 9:10 AM (Event #46 satellite, Dec 12); earliest non-satellite start is 10:00 AM (Day 2 restarts). No one-day main event starts at or before 8:10 AM.

occupancy.status: assumption - not supplied by the traveller; hotel totals change with it

single_entry_rule: Only events whose official structure states one entry per player (no re-entry, no rebuy, no add-on) qualify. Silence does not qualify.
ranking_rule: Rank on confirmed total entry fee and confirmed guarantee only. GTD / entry is a descriptive ratio, not a forecast. Bounty, satellite/flight, restricted-field and other-game events are ranked in a separate section.

quality_floor.status: not supplied - no official quality metric is collected by this project

monitor_first_run_note: This workspace has no outbound access to venue domains (egress allowlist is github/npm/pypi only), so tools/poker4_monitor.py has never made a live call here; its parser is covered by --selftest only. The first real run is the scheduled Actions job after merge. `last checked` therefore stays at 2026-11-17 (the manual read date) until a run writes monitor_state.json.
